requirements.rationale: S02 outcome is assigned to concrete source files with the quoted positive/negative acceptance gate.

evidence.quote: Replay against the injected sink, validating before calls and never owning or inspecting it. Advance virtual time monotonically; append each due detached delivery and accept only exact bool results. Commit each successful cursor/count/clock step; deliver same-time events before querying state. Preserve partial progress on append failure, and do not reappend after state-query failure. No wall clock, sleeps or filesystem in replay.

Scope: assistant_simulator/replay.py and tests/test_candidate.py. Gate: a spy sink observes all due calls before state, exact bool acknowledgements, partial append failure progress, and no reappend after a state-query failure.

requirements.rationale: S03 outcome is assigned to concrete source files with the quoted positive/negative acceptance gate.

evidence.quote: Checkpoint the exact scenario digest/version, cursor, clock and inserted/duplicate counts. Validate hash, types, bounds, count sums and clock/order on restore without sink calls; allow equal-time partial progress. Restore the last saved checkpoint into the same persistent sink with at-least-once retries after append-before-save crashes. Caller owns atomic checkpoint persistence. Never promise exactly-once or fresh-empty-sink recovery; reject corruption and changed scenarios.

Scope: assistant_simulator/replay.py and tests/test_candidate.py. Gate: reject wrong digest/count/clock checkpoints without sink calls, allow equal-time partial progress, and retry append-before-save against the same sink without claiming exactly-once.

requirements.rationale: S04 outcome is assigned to concrete source files with the quoted positive/negative acceptance gate.

evidence.quote: Evaluate every authored checkpoint via fresh replay; validate observed IDs and reject duplicate observations. Compare sorted missing and unexpected sets against unchanged declared expectations. Continue after mismatches and drain deliveries to duration after the last check. Derive counts from actual replay; propagate errors and never fabricate success or replace expectations with observations.

Scope: assistant_simulator/evaluate.py and tests/test_candidate.py. Gate: independently vary missing and unexpected IDs, reject duplicate observed IDs, preserve authored expectations and drain deliveries after the last checkpoint.

requirements.rationale: S05 outcome is assigned to concrete source files with the quoted positive/negative acceptance gate.

evidence.quote: Deliver python -m assistant_simulator validate, schedule and jsonl without importing a journal; run lazily owns and always closes the explicit Journal dependency. Document CLI usage, virtual/event time, dependency, transforms, at-least-once restart, caller checkpoint duties, partial failures and no OS sandbox; preserve public examples and add meaningful tests.

Scope: assistant_simulator/cli.py, tests/test_candidate.py and README.md. Gate: validate/schedule/jsonl work without a Journal; run uses an explicit dependency and DB, closes it, and distinguishes exit 0, mismatch 1 and error 2.
